claim: AttacKG+ uses language models to recover the order of techniques from report text.
quote: Thereafter, given the rewritten sections, the parser extracts the behavior graph, including the atomic event triplets, temporal relations between threat actions, as well as entity–entity relations.
issue: LLM-based: "we propose a fully automatic LLM-based framework to construct attack graphs" (abstract, p. 1). The body adds that the rewriter sorts the report by tactic "according to the chronological relationship" (p. 6).
